rules.name: Take Cover!
rules.description: Slovak infantry or artillery units that have already acted in a turn may elect to change their Order Dice to Down when fired upon. At the end of the turn any unit tht has changed its Orded Dice to Down must remain Down for the next turn, and their Order dice is not returned to the bag. However, Slovak infantry and artillery units who retain their Down Order at the end of the turn do not remove D3 pins as usual.

rules.name: Reliable Weaponry
rules.description: Slovak LMGs (either carried by infantry or mounted on vehicles) cost 5 points less than usual.

rules.name: Jury-rigged machinery
rules.description: Slovak vehicles ignore one pin when modifying their morale value during an Order Test. Note that the vehicle must still test (without modifiers) if it has a single pin on it when issued an Order.

rules.name: Limited Officers
rules.description: Once per game, as soon as an officer has been removed as a casuality, the NCO of the nearest infantry squad within 12" of the officer when he became a casuality takes over the command of the reinforced platoon. He gains the benefits of a Second Lieutenant, thus granting +1 to all order and morale test to his own unit and those within 6" of himself. The newly promoted NCO remanis with his original squad and the officer is still removed as a casuality as per normal. The newly promoted officer is also granted the You Men, Snap to Action! ability.

sharedRules.name: Slovak Calvary
sharedRules.description: Slovak calvary units may move not move into contact with an enemy unit while mounted. On the other hand, Slovak cavalry sections do not suffer the -1 to their leadership roll to arrive from reserve.

sharedRules.name: Off-road specialist
sharedRules.description: May Advance through rough ground at a rate of 9", with a single 90-degree turn.

rules.name: Intelligence
rules.description: Once per game, at the beginning of any turn before the first die is drawn from the dice bag. Roll a D6 and apply modifiers: Inexperienced -1, Veteran +1. On a 4+, the player activating the Intelligence Officer may choose a die from the bag for the first activation. If both players attempt to activate this ability simultaneously, each must roll 1D6. The higher score wins and immediately uses this ability, but the losing player may attempt to use his ability on another turn instead.

characteristics.name: Transport
characteristics.$text: none. Much like empty transports, ambulances are destroyed if they end their turn closer to enemy units than to friendly units.

rules.name: Medical Vehicle
rules.description: Being in proximity of an ambulance means that any wounded soldiers nearby have a chance of being treated by a medic or stretcher bearer from amongst the crew of the ambulance .All infantry and artillery units within 6" of the vehicle count as within 6" of a medic.

rules.name: Versatile
rules.description: This weapon can also be fired as a light howitzer.
